structuredContent.text:
## Problem

The product search index is rebuilt every hour from a full export, which takes 40 minutes and makes new products invisible for up to an hour. Customers filed 23 tickets in July 2026 about missing products.

content.text:
The product search index is rebuilt every hour from a full export. Each rebuild takes 40 minutes. As a result, new products can stay invisible in search for up to an hour. Customers filed 23 tickets about missing products in July 2026.
